g.title: GainPath
g.text: One monorepo - two apps - one backend per environment

g.title: client
g.text: Firebase Auth identity + App Check tokens

g.title: api
g.text: Validate inputs, limits and retry identity

g.title: direct
g.text: Scoped reads and permitted personal edits

g.title: db
g.text: Bookings, ledgers, reports and durable jobs

g.title: delivery
g.text: Push is a hint, not source of truth

g.title: webhook
g.text: Verify provider signature and bill details

g.title: notes
g.text: SHARED SOURCE: domain contracts, portable data adapters, UI primitives; pure pose package used by mobile only.
OPERATIONS: Secret Manager, least-privilege IAM, audit logs, metrics, alerts, backups and recovery tests.
DEPLOYMENT: independent mobile / admin Hosting / Functions / Rules releases; separate dev, staging and production.
SECURITY: server SDK bypasses Firestore Rules; server authorization is mandatory.
